answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the delta check immediately, the quartz audit keeps the resolved set and the karst replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 208 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 208 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
